task.violation: Eradicated arbitrary bracket values (e.g., .mb-[13rem], .min-h-[80px], .min-h-[48px], .h-[400px], .lg:h-[700px]); centralized Tailwind configuration intervals via @theme in globals.css and extended tailwind.config.ts.

Remove `outline:none` lacking fallbacks; enforce high-visibility focus rings across interactive elements and dark background surfaces[cite: 4].

Mandate `rel="noopener noreferrer"` on all `target="_blank"` anchors to neutralize reverse tabnabbing vulnerabilities[cite: 4].
